# Test omitted fields with an exact object assertion

The account test uses assertDeepEqual with strict true for getDefault(false). Its expected rootFolder has no subFolders. The following check deliberately uses a looser comparison when including folders and then asserts both folder fields are arrays. Preserve this distinction when testing absent properties: deleting the property before comparison would hide a null-versus-absence regression.

Scope: mail/components/extensions.
